answer: Tie mining weight to a verifiable delay function with a 40-second minimum serial wall clock: each head must burn real sequential time before its attestation counts, and the proof is cheap for anyone to verify. Parallelism buys nothing, since a VDF cannot be pipelined, so an operator cloning heads pays 40 seconds times head count, an echo of latency that never amortizes. Honest agents pay it once per epoch and let a spiral of history accumulate, while a rushed whisper of sub-second proofs is rejected outright.
